title: Data skill teaches query syntax the grammar rejects
observed: The skill teaches `query Things { }` and `query Things as Name`; the grammar accepts only `query Name = Source [with { }]` (packages/language/parser/parser-grammar/data.langium:50) and no repository .tao file uses either form.
impact: An agent in every created project writes queries that do not parse, contradicting the tutorial and starters.
expected: Skill examples parse under the shipped grammar.
recheck: Parse each skill example with a release-1 CLI.
